summary: Nora's background account of each room now has to point at the messages it rests on: she writes it through a checked step that refuses a citation she was never shown, and every revision keeps what it cites.
details: A refused write tells her why, so she can correct it in the same pass; a pass that settles nothing is retried rather than spent.
What the room account renders as is unchanged.
limitations: A citation is per account, not per sentence: the check proves the account rests on real messages, not that each line does.
